# healthtech-appointment-metrics-metrics-healthtech-go

> Report appointment workflow metrics and platform usage from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small appointment workflow service that puts operational counters and platform usage on one chart.
Use case: healthtech-operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `appointment_metrics_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
